The CLOSED pink umbrella must be unmistakable and not omitted.

Inside float two tiny ivory spirit faces and hard-edged violet wisps. No label or writing. The low wooden cradle has a rectangular foot following the two garden axes, in BOTH views. Never show a flat horizontal front base. Preserve the translucent bottle and wire cage, not a wooden cabinet.

items.label: Rương nháy mắt
items.subject: A small rounded-lid dark wooden Halloween treasure chest with weathered copper bands, lid cracked open enough for exactly two big amber eyes to peek from the darkness. No treasure spilling out, four stable little feet, cute mischievous personality.

items.label: Cổng Halloween bằng rễ cây
items.subject: A freestanding large garden gateway formed by two twisted old tree roots meeting in an arch, two carved pumpkin lanterns integrated into the posts, small bat finial and sparse cobwebs. Open walk-through center, no door, no fence extensions, roots stable on ground.

Dobby grins, one hand raised waving, ears flapping. Cheerful, cute, celebratory. Whole statue including plinth fully visible, the plinth is the ground contact.

Everything elf-sized, warm and busy. The hearth and table stand side by side along a 2x1 tile footprint (long axis along the strip). Bases are the ground contact.
